retained_dataset.note: post-5-core fixed dataset/catalog counts; not necessarily equal to unique training items

local_gap.notes: Local gaps computed from consecutive interactions; log1p applied to gap_days; z-score normalization

recency.notes: Recency is the elapsed time in days from each historical interaction to the final observable interaction of each training prefix; log1p is applied and scale-only normalization is used without mean centering (std=2.231).

effective_sequence_length.notes: Effective sequence length = min(actual_length, max_seq_len=50); log1p applied; z-score normalization

activity_span.notes: Activity span from first to final retained interaction within each training instance; log1p applied; z-score normalization

mean_local_gap.notes: Mean local gap per training instance over adjacent retained positions; no transform; z-score normalization

temporal_prior_mean.explanation: temporal_prior r = exp(-γ * normalized_recency), where γ=0.8 for Sports
temporal_prior_mean.notes: Mean temporal prior over valid retained positions, computed for each training instance. Range necessarily [0, 1]. Z-score normalization applied.

temporal_prior_dispersion.explanation: Standard deviation of temporal prior r values within each training instance
temporal_prior_dispersion.notes: Since r ∈ [0, 1], max std is 0.5. Observed mean of 0.308 is consistent with this constraint. Z-score normalization applied.
